title: NOT A True Seamstress Taylors HAM! don't waste your money weight less than 1/3 of an ounce!!! junk
text:
NOT A True Seamstress Taylors HAM! don't waste your money weight less than 1/3 of an ounce!!! junk. Preteen I worked under a Tailor from Italy guidance. Learning how to make patterns, cutting, differences in wools, to making pattern pieces for each individuals measurement. From shirts, trousers suit coats Trench coats TIES those were wild to do. He taught me everything about templates for cutting the correct necklines for men, women and children. plus, about threads, bias, grain, care of those fabrics, & everything about repairs-mending, sharpening scissors, cleaning the irons, setting correct sewing tensions sticth size & how top hand sew with silk thread, embroidery Ironing, how to calculation how much fabric @ what width would b necessary ETC. THIS PRODUCT IS A VERY BAD JOKE!!
this is not a Seamstress ham! Maybe a children playhouse toy.
